mitre_tactics.name: Exploitation of Remote Services
mitre_tactics.justification: Exploitation of Remote Services (Lateral Movement) — Exploitation of vulnerabilities in remote services to move laterally within the network. Technique ID mapped from threat intelligence corpus.

ttps.justification: Technique applies because: server-side. The Exploitation of Remote Services technique is relevant because this vulnerability's attack mechanism aligns with Lateral Movement phase behavior (analyst inference from advisory text).
ttps.observed_behavior: NOT OBSERVED. Hypothesis from the vulnerability description: exploiting 'CVE-2026-114730 - Roundcube Webmail Server-Side Request Forgery' could enable Exploitation of Remote Services (T1210) in the Lateral Movement phase. No adversary use of this technique is reported by the source.
ttps.detection_hint: Monitor for unusual inbound connections to SMB (445), RDP (3389), WinRM (5985/5986). Alert on lateral movement from unexpected source hosts.
